```{r}
getwd()

data_dir <- file.path("data", "nrel-rooftop-pv")
dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

workbook_url <- paste0(
  "https://data.nlr.gov/system/files/121/",
  "Rooftop_PV_Technical_Potential.xlsx"
)

xlsx_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "Rooftop_PV_Technical_Potential.xlsx"
)

if (!file.exists(xlsx_file)) {
  download.file(
    workbook_url,
    destfile = xlsx_file,
    mode = "wb",
    method = "libcurl"
  )
}

file.exists(xlsx_file)
file.size(xlsx_file)
```

```{r}
suitability_raw <- read_excel(
  xlsx_file,
  sheet = "Small_Building_Suitability"
) |>
  mutate(
    fipsstco = str_pad(as.character(fipsstco), width = 5, pad = "0"),
    state_fips = str_pad(as.character(state_fips), width = 2, pad = "0"),
    zip = str_pad(as.character(zip), width = 5, pad = "0")
  )

glimpse(suitability_raw)
```


```{r}
provenance <- tibble(
  dataset = "Rooftop Photovoltaic Technical Potential in the United States",
  doi = "10.7799/1575064",
  source_url = workbook_url,
  worksheet = "Small_Building_Suitability",
  downloaded_on = Sys.Date(),
  workbook_bytes = file.size(xlsx_file),
  cleaning_rule = "Treat -999 as missing; retain nonnegative nbld and pct_suitab in [0, 1]"
)

provenance
```


## Q1b

```{r}
suitability_raw |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    states_and_dc = n_distinct(state),
    zip_keys = n_distinct(zip),
    counties = n_distinct(county),
    counties_fips = n_distinct(fipsstco),
    minimum_building_count = min(nbld),
    minimum_suitability = min(pct_suitab)
  )
```

```{r}
suitability_raw |> 
  filter(nbld == -999) |> 
  nrow()
```


```{r}
suitability_raw |> 
  filter(pct_suitab == -999) |> 
  nrow()
```


```{r}
ny_raw <- suitability_raw |>
  filter(state == "NY")


tmp <- ny_raw |> 
  summarize(n_zipcode = n_distinct(zip))

ny_audit <- ny_raw |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    zip_keys = n_distinct(zip),
    counties = n_distinct(county),
    counties_fips = n_distinct(fipsstco),
    negative_building_counts = sum(nbld < 0),
    zero_building_counts = sum(nbld == 0),
    invalid_suitability = sum(!between(pct_suitab, 0, 1)),
    rows_with_a_sentinel = sum(
      nbld < 0 | !between(pct_suitab, 0, 1)
    )
  )

ny_audit
```


```{r}
ny_raw |>
  filter(nbld < 0 | !between(pct_suitab, 0, 1)) |>
  select(state_zip, county, nbld, pct_suitab) |>
  arrange(nbld, pct_suitab)
```

```{r}
ny_raw |> 
  filter(county == "NEW YORK") |> 
  select(state_zip, county, nbld, pct_suitab) |>
  arrange(nbld, pct_suitab)
```

```{r}
ny_raw |>

```

```{r}
ny_raw |> 
  filter(nbld == 0) |>
```

```{r}

tmp <- ny_raw |>
  mutate(
    nbld = na_if(nbld, -999),
    pct_suitab = na_if(pct_suitab, -999)
  ) 


library(skimr)
nbld_sum <- skim(tmp$nbld)
nbld_sum_raw <- skim(ny_raw$nbld)



ny_suitability <- ny_raw |>
  mutate( 
    nbld = na_if(nbld, -999),  # nbld = ifelse(nbld == -999, NA, nbld)
    pct_suitab = na_if(pct_suitab, -999)  # pct_suitab = ifelse(pct_suitab == -999, NA, pct_suitab)
  ) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(nbld),
    !is.na(pct_suitab),
    nbld >= 0,
    between(pct_suitab, 0, 1)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    estimated_suitable_buildings = nbld * pct_suitab
  )

ny_suitability |>
  summarise(
    zip_rows = n(),
    counties = n_distinct(fipsstco),
    modeled_small_buildings = sum(nbld),
    estimated_suitable_buildings = sum(estimated_suitable_buildings)
  )
```

```{r}
state_summary <- ny_suitability |>
  summarise(
    zip_rows = n(),
    modeled_small_buildings = sum(nbld),
    unweighted_zip_mean = mean(pct_suitab),
    estimated_suitable_buildings = sum(estimated_suitable_buildings),
    building_weighted_suitability =
      sum(estimated_suitable_buildings) / sum(nbld)
  )

state_summary
```



```{r}
county_suitability <- ny_suitability |>
  group_by(fipsstco, county) |>
  summarise(
    zip_rows = n(),
    modeled_small_buildings = sum(nbld),
    estimated_suitable_buildings = sum(estimated_suitable_buildings),
    unweighted_zip_mean = mean(pct_suitab),
    building_weighted_suitability =
      sum(estimated_suitable_buildings) / sum(nbld),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county))

county_suitability
```



```{r}
statewide_rate <- state_summary |>
  pull(building_weighted_suitability)

ggplot(
  county_suitability,
  aes(x = building_weighted_suitability)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.01,
    boundary = 0,
    color = "white",
    fill = "#2e7d5b"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = statewide_rate,
    color = "#c65d21",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Modeled small-building rooftop suitability varies across New York counties",
    subtitle = "County estimates weight ZIP rows by NREL's modeled small-building count",
    x = "Estimated share of small buildings with some suitable roof area",
    y = "Counties",
    caption = "Source: Gagnon, Margolis, and Phillips (2019), NREL technical-potential dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
